text: 中国9月末黄金储备报7747万盎司（约2409.59吨），环比增加74万盎司（约23.02吨），8月末黄金储备报7673万盎司（约2386.57吨）。中国央行已连续第23个月增持黄金。
text_en: China's gold reserves at the end of September were 77.47 million ounces (about 2,409.59 tons), up 740,000 ounces (about 23.02 tons) from the end of August, when reserves were 76.73 million ounces (about 2,386.57 tons). The People's Bank of China has increased its gold holdings for a 23rd consecutive month.
